core_obligations: Show that the difference of the two structure-sheaf maps factors through the conormal sheaf using the square-zero condition.
Verify the Leibniz rule, exhibiting the difference as an O_B-derivation.

proof_roadmap.step: Compare the two structure-sheaf maps and identify their difference.
Use square-zero to land in the conormal sheaf.
Check the Leibniz rule to obtain a derivation.

difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that two morphisms of first order thickenings of algebraic spaces that agree on the closed parts and induce the same map on conormal sheaves differ, at the level of structure sheaves, by a derivation into the pushforward of the conormal sheaf. The proof identifies the difference of the two structure-sheaf maps, uses the square-zero condition to see that it lands in the conormal sheaf, and verifies the Leibniz rule to exhibit it as a derivation. Producing the factorisation and checking the derivation property is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 3688-3707 statement, proof 3709-3740.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: this side treats first order thickenings of algebraic spaces over a base algebraic space B; the schemes side treats thickenings of schemes. Conclusion difference: both conclude the difference is a derivation, but over different categories and base objects, so they are distinct propositions and both count.
